title: Notion Workspace Operations
description: Search, read, and edit Notion pages, databases, and data sources via the official Notion MCP server.

env_vars.name: NOTION_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Notion internal-integration secret (`ntn_…`). Issue from notion.so/profile/integrations; it scopes which pages and databases the server can reach. Pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS
env_vars.description: Advanced alternative to NOTION_TOKEN: a JSON string of HTTP headers (e.g. an Authorization bearer plus a Notion-Version header). Use either NOTION_TOKEN or this; pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

auth.recipe: create an internal integration at notion.so/profile/integrations, share the target pages/databases with it (Access tab), then set NOTION_TOKEN to the integration secret (`ntn_…`); OPENAPI_MCP_HEADERS is an advanced header-based alternative.

sample_tools.name: query-data-source
sample_tools.summary: Query a Notion data source (database) with filters and sorts (uses `data_source_id`).

sample_tools.name: retrieve-a-data-source
sample_tools.summary: Get the schema and metadata for a data source.

sample_tools.name: retrieve-a-database
sample_tools.summary: Get database metadata, including its data-source IDs.

sample_tools.name: retrieve-page-markdown
sample_tools.summary: Read a page's full content as token-efficient Markdown.

sample_tools.name: update-page-markdown
sample_tools.summary: Edit a page's content with Markdown (`replace_content` or targeted `update_content`).

sample_tools.name: move-page
sample_tools.summary: Move a page to a different parent page or data source.

known_limitations: Requires a Notion internal-integration token (NOTION_TOKEN); without it the server attaches but every Notion API tool returns an auth error.
Tools only see pages and databases explicitly shared with the integration — connect each target via the integration's Access tab first, or tools return empty / not-found.
v2.0+ migrated databases to the data-source model (Notion API 2025-09-03): database operations use `data_source_id`, and the legacy create/update/query `*-a-database` tools were removed.

Destructive-action audit (X2.18): block deletion (`delete-a-block`) is flagged in `destructive_tools`; the Notion integration scope excludes database deletion, and the trust policy sets `allowDestructive: false` (per-call confirm, X1.6 evidence).

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `notion`: { command: npx, args: [-y, @notionhq/notion-mcp-server], env: { NOTION_TOKEN: "ntn_..." } }.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `notion`, command `npx -y @notionhq/notion-mcp-server`; set NOTION_TOKEN in the env.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `notion` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); supply NOTION_TOKEN via inputs.
